name: tradipitant
uses: 1 INDICATIONS AND USAGE NEREUS is indicated for the prevention of vomiting induced by motion in adults. NEREUS is a substance P/neurokinin 1 (NK1) receptor antagonist indicated for the prevention of vomiting induced by motion in adults. ( 1 )
pediatric: 7.1 Effects of Other Drugs on NEREUS Strong CYP3A4 Inhibitors Tradipitant is a CYP3A4 substrate. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase tradipitant exposure, which may increase the risk of adverse reactions to NEREUS. 8.4 Pediatric Use The safety and effectiveness of NEREUS have not been established in pediatric patients.
interactions: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Strong CYP3A4 Inhibitors: May increase tradipitant exposure and the risk of adverse reactions.
